_references.selection: Thirty ordinary, weakly barred, or barred spiral disks. No dedicated irregular, collisional-ring, or ongoing-merger model. NGC 1300 and NGC 2997 are reviewed ordinary spiral approximations with unmodeled resonance-pseudoring details. Catalog isophotal diameters vary by passband and omit fainter outskirts.
